title.zh: 将拉斯皮纳斯区医院改设为医疗中心，名称为拉斯皮纳斯总医院与卫星创伤中心，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An act converting the Las Piñas District Hospital into a Medical Center to be known as the Las Piñas General Hospital and Satellite Trauma Center and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An act converting the Las Piñas District Hospital into a Medical Center to be known as the Las Piñas General Hospital and Satellite Trauma Center and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Bệnh viện Huyện Las Piñas thành Trung tâm Y tế với tên gọi Trung tâm Chấn thương Las Piñas General Hospital and Satellite, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงพยาบาลอำเภอ Las Piñas เป็น ศูนย์การแพทย์ในชื่อศูนย์บาดเจ็บ Las Piñas General Hospital and Satellite และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Rumah Sakit Distrik Las Piñas menjadi Pusat Medis dengan nama Pusat Trauma Las Piñas General Hospital and Satellite, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menukar status Hospital Daerah Las Piñas kepada Pusat Perubatan dengan nama Pusat Trauma Las Piñas General Hospital and Satellite, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

text.en: The Las Piñas District Hospital in Las Piñas City is hereby converted into a medical center to be known as the Las Piñas General Hospital and Satellite Trauma Center.

The bed capacity of the Las Piñas District Hospital shall be increased from fifty (50) to two hundred (200) beds: Provided, That the increase shall be done gradually over a three (3)-year period, starting from the year 2004 until the year 2006: Provided, further, That for every year, fifty (50) beds shall be added to the hospital.
The Secretary of Health shall immediately include in the Department's program the implementation of this Act. The funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
